_about: THE PORT'S OWN RULES, laid over the web's tables (content/rules.json, which the export writes and the parity replay reads alone). Each block says why. Rules.data() merges this in for the game; Rules.web_only (the parity runner) leaves it out.
_crates: Crate rebalance, 2026-10-01 (Kong). The web rolled crates at a flat 2% a cast everywhere, so the shallows, with the shortest waits, gave the most crates an hour and crate income was flat across the sea; a diamond paid little more than a gold; wooden and metal could never hold a cosmetic. Now the chance climbs with the water (about 3 crates an hour anywhere), the tiers climb with it (no diamonds in the shallows), and each tier is strictly better than the one below.
